'''Magic Holidays''' is a brand belonging to Panoramic Holidays Ltd. (PHL).  PHL is a timeshare company, part of Panoramic Group. It was founded in 2009 to provide holidays on a timeshare basis.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.franchiseindia.com/Magic-Holidays-repositions-brand-5141/#.UuZAI7ThXIU |title=MAGIC HOLIDAYS REPOSITIONS BRAND|publisher=Franchise India |accessdate=2013-04-06}}</ref> Magic Holidays has over 37 [[hotels]] & [[resorts]] in [[India]] and abroad. In 2013, it was reported that the company is working towards building and acquiring additional resorts around the world.<ref>{{cite web|url= http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/magic-holidays-to-have-100-resorts-in-5-years/article5124377.ece |title=Magic Holidays to have 100 resorts in 5 years |publisher= The Hindu Business line |accessdate=2013-07-30}}</ref> Magic Holidays is an affiliate of Resorts Condominium International (RCI),  the largest timeshare vacation exchange network in the world. Magic Holidays has access to properties in more than 103 countries.
<ref>{{cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/other-press-releases/press-release-magic-holidays-targets-100-resorts-in-next-two-years/articleshow/21523769.cms |title=Magic Holidays targets 100 resorts in next two years|publisher=Economic Times |accessdate=2013-08-30}}</ref>

==History==
Panoramic Holidays Ltd., (PHL) is a part of the hospitality vertical of the Panoramic Group. Founded in 2009, Magic Holidays currently has over 8387 members (approx. number) and more than 37 hotels & resorts in India and abroad.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.magicholidays.info/about-us/company-profile |title=Magic Holidays |publisher=Magic Holidays |accessdate=2013-09-15}}</ref>
